Callout.Name: Collapse After Exercise
Callout.Message: Runner collapsed at the end of a race.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, hot and dry, event medics on scene.

Script.Line: It was a half marathon. I have done the distance plenty of times.
I stopped sweating about four miles back. That is when it went wrong.
Water. Not a bottle. All of it.

Callout.Patient: I finished it. Did I finish it?

Lines.Approach: Hot, dry and confused at the end of a race. Get fluids into him before anything else.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
